title.ja: 角交換四間飛車 逆棒銀の攻め方・練習問題

intro.ja: 「角交換四間飛車 逆棒銀の攻め方」で学んだ形を、実際に手順を指して確認します。
intro.en: Play through the moves to check what you learned in “Reverse Climbing Silver”.

courses.title: 角交換四間飛車 逆棒銀の攻め方・練習問題: 8筋から逆棒銀
courses.titleEn: Reverse Climbing Silver practice: Reverse Climbing Silver on the eighth file

branches.note: 学習用の基本手順。角道を開ける。
branches.noteEn: Teaching sequence; adapt to different replies. Open the bishop diagonal.
Open White’s bishop diagonal.
Transfer the rook to the sixth file.
Advance White’s rook pawn.
Begin moving Black’s king toward the right wing.
Prepare a breakthrough on 8f.
Continue the king toward 3h.
Move White’s king away from its rook.

branches.note: 角を交換し、角打ちのある戦いにする。
branches.noteEn: Exchange bishops, introducing bishop-drop possibilities.
Recapture the bishop with the silver.

branches.note: 銀を8八へ置き、角打ちの隙を減らす。
branches.noteEn: Place the silver on 8h to reduce bishop-drop weaknesses.

branches.note: 銀を3三へ戻し、2筋を守る。
branches.noteEn: Develop the silver to 3c to cover the second file.

branches.note: 角頭を守る駒を7七へ置く。
branches.noteEn: Place a defender on 7g to cover the bishop-head area.
Develop White’s left silver toward the center.

branches.note: 玉を美濃の2八へ入れる。
branches.noteEn: Place the king on Mino’s 2h square.
Continue White’s king toward 3b.

branches.note: 銀を3八へ上げ、玉の前を守る。
branches.noteEn: Place the silver on 3h to defend in front of the king.
Bring White’s left gold toward the center.

branches.note: 飛車を8筋へ回し、相手の飛車に向き合う。
branches.noteEn: Transfer the rook to the eighth file to confront the enemy rook.
Move the gold to 4b.

branches.note: 8筋の歩をぶつけ、銀で取る場所を作る。
branches.noteEn: Challenge the eighth-file pawn to create a recapture square for the silver.
Exchange the eighth-file pawn.

branches.note: 銀で歩を取り、逆棒銀の進出を始める。
branches.noteEn: Recapture with the silver to begin Reverse Climbing Silver.
